darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shares its NetSuite ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: true when another sellable product carries the same NetSuite id.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: NetSuite ID state
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: OWN: keyed on its NetSuite id; NONE: it has none (nsKey HOTWAX-ONLY:productId); SHARED: another product holds the id first (nsKey DUPLICATE:id:productId).

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: NetSuite item ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The NETSUITE_PRODUCT_ID identification, blank when the product has none.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Not sellable because
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: discontinued, virtual, or the product type (DIGITAL_GOOD, SERVICE ...) when sellable is N.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: NetSuite item ID (key)
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The compare key: the product's NETSUITE_PRODUCT_ID (the NetSuite item internal id); HOTWAX-ONLY:productId when it has none, DUPLICATE:id:productId for every product after the first sharing one.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Sellable
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: Y for a sellable product; N for a discontinued, virtual or non-selling product kept only because it carries a NetSuite id no sellable product holds.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Shares its NetSuite ID with
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: The other sellable HotWax products carrying the same NetSuite id, comma-separated.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Transaction ids
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: DAR-BE-153: comma-joined ids of every SUCCESS transaction on the order, any kind (authorization, capture, sale, void, refund). Each HotWax OPP manualRefNum must be among them (paymentRefNums all in transactionIds); extra Shopify ids are fine.
